objective: In this workspace, `src/relay/workspace/command-runner.ts` runs an approved command and returns its stdout and stderr, bounded to `outputLimitBytes` and with secret-shaped substrings redacted by `src/relay/workspace/output-sanitizer.ts`, because the result is stored in evidence and shown to people. Three things about how it does that are wrong. (1) `boundOutput` guesses the byte count (every non-ASCII UTF-16 unit as three bytes) and cuts at a UTF-16 unit, so it keeps less accented text than the budget allows and can cut an emoji in half, leaving a lone surrogate. (2) The runner decodes each stream chunk by chunk with `chunk.toString('utf8')`, so a multi-byte character whose bytes arrive in two reads becomes two U+FFFD replacement characters and is lost. (3) The runner bounds first and redacts second, so a secret-shaped value that straddles the limit is cut into something too short for any redaction pattern to match and its first characters are stored in clear; and because the redaction mark is longer than a short secret, redacting after bounding can store MORE than the bound the caller asked for. Make the stored output safe: exact UTF-8 bounding that never splits a character, correct decoding across reads, and an order of operations under which no part of a secret is stored in clear and the stored size honours the caller's bound. `seed/src/relay/workspace/output-safety.test.ts` is already written and currently fails; it drives the real runner against real child processes. The two files to edit exist and are tracked by git: edit them in place.
requirements: `boundOutput(text, limitBytes)` must treat the limit as a count of UTF-8 BYTES. Text whose UTF-8 size is within the limit is returned unchanged with `truncated: false`; otherwise it returns the LONGEST prefix whose UTF-8 size fits, never ending inside a character (no lone surrogate, no half of an astral character), followed by the existing truncation mark, once.

`runBoundedCommand` must decode stdout and stderr as UTF-8 streams, so a character whose bytes are split across reads is delivered intact on both streams, and no U+FFFD is introduced by the runner for valid input.

No part of a secret-shaped value that begins inside the captured output may be stored in clear because the output limit fell inside it. The stored stdout and stderr must never exceed `outputLimitBytes` plus the truncation mark in size, even when redaction lengthens the text.

Everything else about `runBoundedCommand` keeps its behaviour exactly: the result fields and their meanings (`exitCode`, `signal`, `timedOut`, `cancelled`, `truncated`, `outputLimitHit`, `termination`, `durationMs`, `spawnError`), `shell: false`, the SIGTERM then SIGKILL escalation, the capture cap that stops the process when a stream passes the limit, and `redactions` as the number of secret-shaped values redacted in what was captured.
`sanitizeOutput` keeps finding exactly what it finds today; this is not a change to the redaction patterns.
constraints: Edit `src/relay/workspace/output-sanitizer.ts` and `src/relay/workspace/command-runner.ts` in place. You have `Read`, `Glob`, `Grep` and `Edit`; you cannot create files or run commands, and you do not need to.
Do not edit `src/relay/workspace/output-safety.test.ts`. It is the specification you are implementing against, not part of the deliverable.
Use only Node built-ins. Add no dependency and no import from outside this workspace: the sandbox that runs the test has no network access and no `node_modules`.
Do not change the exported names or signatures of `boundOutput`, `sanitizeOutput`, `REDACTION_MARK`, `runBoundedCommand`, `BoundedRunRequest` or `BoundedRunOutcome`.
Do not reformat code you are not changing, and do not touch `.julius/`.

acceptanceCriteria.text: `boundOutput` counts UTF-8 bytes exactly: text within the limit is returned unchanged and untruncated, and otherwise the longest fitting prefix is kept, never ending inside a character, followed by the truncation mark once.
stdout and stderr are decoded as UTF-8 streams in the runner, so a multi-byte character split across reads arrives intact on both streams.
When the output limit falls inside a secret-shaped value, no part of that value is stored in clear in stdout or stderr.
The stored stdout and stderr never exceed `outputLimitBytes` plus the truncation mark, including when redaction replaces short secrets with the longer redaction mark.

The runner's result fields and their meanings, `shell: false`, the SIGTERM then SIGKILL escalation, the capture cap and the `redactions` count are unchanged, and `sanitizeOutput` and its patterns are not modified.
Only `output-sanitizer.ts` and `command-runner.ts` are changed, using Node built-ins only, with no change to exported names or signatures and no reformatting of code that did not need to change.
